title: AttemptDB Inference v1 upload
description: One upload of device-computed inferences of a single kind (RFC 0006 §10.7). Inferences are not facts (RFC 0003): each item must carry its provenance — the event ids it was derived from, a confidence in [0, 1], and the algorithm version — and a server stores them beside, never inside, the event database.

algorithm_version.description: Version of the projection algorithm that produced every item (e.g. tier1-v0).

computed_at.description: When the projection was computed: microseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC), as every timestamp in Event v1.

kind.description: Inference kinds that leave a device. Sessions, turns, tool calls and causal edges are one-to-one with facts or derivable from them and are not uploaded.

id.description: Stable within (device, kind); a re-upload replaces the item.

evidence.description: Event ids this inference was derived from. Never empty.

fields.description: The projection row without the provenance fields above. Under metadata-only policy the content-bearing fields `objective` and `rationale` are null.
